note: モーター commonly suggests an electric motor; 原動機 is the general machine converting energy into mechanical motion (ent_seq:1262200).
糸 is the ordinary thread or yarn used in needlework, and chỉ is the standard Vietnamese equivalent for thread.
量る has a direct weigh sense for determining an object's weight; cân is the normal Vietnamese verb for weighing.
かばん often suggests personal luggage; バッグ is the broader everyday bag term covering shopping and travel bags (ent_seq:1099100).
営業 directly covers business, trade, and operating activities, matching the stated business or operations sense.
失う fits losing possession of something, but the underspecified English gloss also covers misplacing an item or losing a contest, which require different Japanese verbs.
者 is formal or literary for a general learner entry; 人 is the neutral everyday word for person (ent_seq:1580640).
週間 directly denotes a period of a week, which matches the stated duration sense.
順 directly covers order, turn, and sorting, matching the sense as listed.
書物 is formal or literary; 本 is the neutral everyday word for a book or volume (ent_seq:1522150).
年間 directly means a period of a year and fits the stated duration sense.
彼等 is restricted to human groups; English they also refers to objects, while Japanese uses different context-dependent forms and has no single equivalent here.
The definition is a prepositional use of under supervision or rules, not a noun; preposition corrects the English POS.
様子 also means state or behavior; 見た目 specifically means physical appearance or look (ent_seq:1611750).
どれ is normally used among three or more choices and どちら among two; the packet gives no single cardinality, so the general English pronoun has no one-form match.
費用 is limited to monetary expenses; コスト directly covers amounts of money, time, or other resources required or used (ent_seq:1050080).
褒める and khen ngợi fit commendation, while the English definition also includes worship; it combines distinct senses without one natural pair covering them.
シート includes sheets of other materials and tờ alone is a classifier; 用紙 means a sheet of paper (ent_seq:1546290) and tờ giấy is the natural Vietnamese phrase.
味わう can imply savoring; 味見する means tasting or sampling, with 味見 attested as a suru-verb noun (ent_seq:1722300).
持分 usually means a legal or financial stake; 取り分 directly denotes an allocated share or portion (ent_seq:1654730).
際 can denote the physical edge or boundary of a surface, and cạnh is the common Vietnamese word for an edge.
約束 and lời hứa are general promises; 誓い means an oath or vow (ent_seq:1381200), and lời thề is the Vietnamese vow term.
名前 is name generally; 下の名前 is the specific given or first name (ent_seq:2127570).
ラジオ often names the receiver; 無線 directly means radio communication or wireless transmission (ent_seq:1530380), matching the technology sense.
溶液 and dung dịch usually suggest liquid solutions; 溶体 is the technical all-phase solution term (ent_seq:2858539), while hỗn hợp đồng nhất states the broader homogeneous-mixture definition.
便り fits personal correspondence and tidings but not general media news; the English gloss combines distinct news and letter senses.
あなた自身 makes the second-person referent explicit; 自身 is directly glossed yourself (ent_seq:1318000).
カラー is common in some design and product contexts; 色 is the neutral general Japanese noun for color (ent_seq:1357600).
フリー can mean unrestricted or freelance; 無料 directly means free of charge (ent_seq:1531040).
宴会 is a natural match for the listed banquet, reception, feast, and dinner gathering sense of party.
腰掛ける is limited to sitting on a chair or bench; 座る is the general verb to sit down (ent_seq:1291800).
全般 means overall or in general; 全体 directly means the whole or entirety (ent_seq:1395660).
体系 usually means an organized framework; システム is the general word for a system or organization (ent_seq:1060300).
発想 leans toward conception or way of thinking; アイデア is the general word for an idea (ent_seq:1014210).
そうして often means and then; そして is the general conjunction and (ent_seq:1006730).
競争する means compete broadly; 競走 is the specific race or contest and is used as a suru verb (ent_seq:1234190).
口座 is a bank account; 勘定 also means an account or settlement in reckoning transactions (ent_seq:1210750), closer to the definition.
鐘 usually means a large hanging bell; ベル is the general Japanese word for a bell (ent_seq:1120010).
旅行 directly means a trip or journey, and cuộc hành trình is a natural Vietnamese equivalent for a discrete journey.
吸う has a direct sense of smoking a cigarette, and hút thuốc is the normal Vietnamese verb for smoking.
